extraction_notes: The supplied PDF identifies 2SC2884 as an NPN transistor and names Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd.; the title and device marking match the requested MPN and manufacturer.

The hFE table gives a guaranteed minimum of 100 and maximum of 320 at IC=100 mA and VCE=1.0 V, plus a guaranteed minimum of 35 at IC=700 mA and VCE=1.0 V, all at Ta=25 degC. Classification ranges on p. 2 are O=100-200 and Y=160-320; no typical hFE was inferred from those bounds.

The only tabulated saturation pair is VCE(sat) maximum 0.5 V and VBE(sat) maximum 0.8 V at IC=500 mA and IB=20 mA, Ta=25 degC; the plotted saturation curves use IC:IB=25:1 and are retained separately as digitized observations.

Absolute maximum and breakdown data include VCBO=35 V, VCEO=30 V, VEBO=5.0 V, IC=0.8 A, PC=0.5 W, Tj=150 degC, Tstg=-55 to +150 degC, and RthetaJ-A=250 degC/W at Ta=25 degC unless otherwise specified. V(BR)CBO minimum is 35 V at IC=1 mA, IE=0; V(BR)EBO minimum is 5.0 V at IE=1 mA, IC=0.

Figures 1 through 5 on p. 2-3 were manually digitized as compact approximate observations of visible DC curves. The points are direct plotted reads and no intermediate points were interpolated or invented. Figure 6 is an AC capacitance-versus-reverse-voltage graph and is intentionally omitted from curves for this DC-focused F2 extraction.
No scalar Cobo or Cibo value is tabulated. Because the extraction is limited to usable DC F2 evidence, the Fig. 6 capacitance curves are not included and cobo and cibo remain null.

The small-signal table gives typical fT=120 MHz at IC=10 mA and VCE=5 V, Ta=25 degC. Switching storage time is specified as a maximum 200 ns at IC=10 mA with IB1=IB2=1 mA; no storage-time field is available in this schema.
No scalar Early voltage was extracted; the static characteristic is retained as curve evidence without inferring a VAF value.
